scope: Local source delivery only. All provider/OAuth/public-page receipts are explicit synthetic fixtures, never genuine owner consent or publication.

backend.mode: Guarded demo emulators + explicit Blogger doubles; no production authorization or publication.

results.name: Default mode permits Blogger only and advertises the exact canonical callback
Google aliases and the existing vault key are strict, without rotating keys
Strict reviewed inputs reject provider credentials, old Pinterest API fields and unreviewed content
HTML is restricted to balanced article tags, with no script, event attributes, comments or image bytes
Manual artwork accepts a local download or a public URL, not embedded bytes/private hosts
UTC ordering and IANA/DST validation reject reversed targets and ambiguous/nonexistent local times
Pin copy preserves plain description newlines while invalid UTC calendar dates fail closed
Creation is owner-scoped, idempotent and does not call any publishing provider
Concurrent identical creation persists exactly one parent and one immutable manual-task ID
An accepted request can be replayed after time passes and after disconnection without creating a new job
Draft -> publish -> public verification uses one saved post and only then releases the manual pack
Future publishDate is registered immediately, without a POST body, and SCHEDULED is never relabeled LIVE
A still-SCHEDULED or future-dated remote post is polled, with no new insertion/publication
LIVE in the admin API still needs a matching unauthenticated public page
Public post URLs must belong to the verified blog, never a guessed slug or another host
Concurrent processing of the same job sends only one draft mutation
A definite rejected publish retries the saved draft, preserving the logical three-attempt budget
Three definite failures stop; explicit Retry cannot reset the attempt count
A timed-out/5xx draft mutation becomes needs_review and never automatically reinserts
Unexpected accepted draft receipts retain a usable remote ID for inspection
An accepted publish with an invalid status is uncertain, not a fake successful schedule
Malformed and oversized accepted HTTP mutation bodies force inspection at draft and publish checkpoints
An accepted Blogger result followed by a rejected checkpoint preserves its ID and blocks another mutation
A lost successful Firestore checkpoint acknowledgement resumes only its saved next phase
If all post-send writes fail, the pre-send marker survives and lease recovery requires inspection
Inspection requires this job’s marker and an owned post, not just a supplied URL/ID
Owner-abandoned uncertainty never fabricates a publication or deletes a remote post
Lease expiry before send prevents the mutation, without declaring publication success
Interrupted leases with mutation markers require review; no-mutation interruptions can retry
A late accepted response cannot overwrite another lease’s uncertainty state
Connection mutation locks serialize two jobs and reject OAuth replacement while a send is in flight
Disconnect wins locally during an in-flight send and cannot resurrect credentials
Reconnection must preserve Google identity, re-verify the blog, and explicitly reconfirm Retry
A different Google identity cannot take over a saved job even with a verified same blog
A removed or URL-changed website stops a queued job before the first mutation
Website removal, reassignment and revision changes during preflight stop the next draft or publish send
Website changes during an already-sent draft preserve its ID but block the following publish checkpoint
Subscription capacity is enforced again immediately before publication, not just during review
Disabled or no-longer-verified managed owners cannot authorize scheduled mutations
One 401 causes one refreshed-token retry; a second 401 requires reconnect
Expired offline authorization is actionable and browser receipts never contain tokens
Google refresh grants remain per-owner encrypted and no access token is persisted
429 pauses the whole runner and an owner cannot bypass its recorded backoff
Manual Pin completion is only user-reported and cannot accept arbitrary/social-shortened URLs
Manual export is a valid offline ZIP with copy and optional artwork, never a Pin receipt
Legacy entrypoints do not generate, refresh Pinterest or publish in the selected manual mode
Errors, workflow and CLI guardrails do not disclose credentials or install a browser publisher
Bounded runner records only its own summary heartbeat and never counts manual links as API results
Direct Node CLI closes its client and returns only a zero-due summary under explicit local guards

productionBuildAPIAndBrowser.mode: Production-build Next APIs, Chromium and local demo Firebase only. OAuth/Blogger/public-page receipts are explicit process-local doubles. No real owner consent or external publication.

results.name: Unauthenticated publishing endpoints reject access instead of returning example jobs
Cross-origin mutations and old Pinterest/session payloads are rejected by actual API routes
Pinterest consent and callback are disabled in manual mode; no API/session connection is required
Retained Pinterest queue and automation routes cannot enqueue or enable API publishing in manual mode
Blogger OAuth start uses offline+PKCE consent and a callback-scoped HttpOnly cookie
The canonical Blogger callback exchanges synthetic consent once, clears its exact cookie, then rejects replay
Actual resource and website APIs return only the authorized owned Blogger destination
Actual reviewed-create API is immutable and idempotent, with owner-only access
Real API checkpoint calls use synthetic draft+publish+public verification, releasing a separate manual task
Actual future-publish API records SCHEDULED without inventing a live article or a Pin
A synthetic lost draft response stops at needs_review; Retry cannot blindly insert another post
Connector presents Blogger consent and manual Pinterest instructions, with no boards or Trial controls
Existing offline article generation still works without activating publishing
The review composer defaults to local artwork, no Pinterest account/host requirement, with an unchecked consent gate
Local artwork can be previewed and downloaded as a real PNG without uploading its bytes to an API
Editing content invalidates previous review consent before any publication button activates
Explicit review publishes only this blog through saved checkpoints; Pinterest remains manual
Jobs separates verified live articles from unverified manual Pin packs and offers copy/export
Copy destination writes the confirmed Blogger URL to the real browser clipboard
The manual pack ZIP contains real reviewed copy, the verified URL and locally attached PNG
Manual completion needs owner confirmation and is visibly labeled user-reported, not API verified
Dashboard and old automation URL explain the selected path rather than requiring a Pinterest API account
Home, footer and policies clearly describe manual Pinterest rather than promise automatic Pin uploads
Subscription retains reviewer-gated capacity without selling automatic Pinterest uploads
Reviewed publishing surfaces remain contained at 320px
Reviewed publishing surfaces remain contained at 390px
Reviewed publishing surfaces remain contained at 768px
Reviewed publishing surfaces remain contained at 1440px
A late owner jobs response cannot leak into a different signed-in account in the same tab
Browser-facing API receipts never include raw grants, ciphertext, session values or uploaded image bytes
The configured production-build browser pages have no uncaught runtime or unexpected console errors
